title: Engineering Profile
intro: I engineer systems with a focus on long-term maintainability, predictable performance, and developer experience. Code is read far more often than it is written.

items.heading: Composition over Inheritance
items.description: Building small, isolated, and highly reusable primitives prevents architectural lock-in and reduces regression risks.

items.heading: Strict Type Safety
items.description: TypeScript is not optional. End-to-end type safety acts as living documentation and catches logic errors at compile time.

items.heading: Zero Unjustified Dependencies
items.description: Every third-party package is a liability. I strictly audit dependencies for bundle size, security, and maintenance status before introduction.

items.heading: Atomic Commits & PRs
items.description: Pull requests should do one thing. This makes code reviews effective, rollbacks trivial, and git history readable.

items.heading: Automated Quality Gates
items.description: CI/CD pipelines must enforce linting, formatting, type-checking, and passing test suites before any merge is allowed.
